title: Home Batteries: What to Know and What They Pay
desc: What to check before you buy a home battery, and every open battery rebate we track, with the official page and the date we checked each one.
lead: A home battery stores power for outages and peak hours. Here is what to check before you buy, and which programs pay today.
image_alt: A modern white house at dusk
intro:
A home battery stores electricity so you can use it later. It can keep the lights on in an outage, and some utilities pay you to use it at busy times.

Battery rebates are the most rule-heavy of the upgrades. Some pay only when the battery goes in with new solar. Some pay more when you join a program that lets the utility draw on your battery at peak times. Some products are excluded by name. Read the program page before you pick a model.
checks: Is it on the list? Programs pay for batteries on their own qualified list, and some brands are excluded.
Enrollment. Some programs pay more if you enrol in a peak-time program within a set number of days. Put the date on your calendar.
Solar or not. Some programs pay for a battery only with new solar. Others pay a battery alone.
Size. Programs set a minimum size and pay per kilowatt-hour up to a cap.
The installer. Many programs need a licensed or registered contractor.
faq: Will a battery power my whole house?
It depends on the battery size and what you plug into it. Ask your installer what it can run and for how long.
It can, if your utility has peak-time rates or pays for enrollment. Check the program page for the numbers.

extra:
Outage backup or bill savings?

Decide what you want the battery for before you shop. If you want backup power, ask what circuits it will keep running and for how many hours. If you want bill savings, ask your installer to show the math using your own rates, because the answer depends on your utility.

Some homeowners add a battery later, after solar. Check first, because a few programs pay for a battery only when it goes in with new solar in the same project. If you are close to doing both, quote them together.
